headline: Nasdaq-100 off its session low as chip weakness is partly offset by a record Nvidia buyback; Tail stays in the watch band with extreme Stress
body: As of the 15:00Z clock-hour the Nasdaq-100 trades at 30,217.51, down 390.62 points or 1.28%, after a gap-down open at 30,426.63 from Friday's 30,608.13 close. The session high of 30,480.40 left the gap unfilled, price then traded down to 30,081.06 and has since recovered roughly 136 points, so a meaningful retracement has occurred rather than a shallow-pullback, repeated-extension path. VIX is 16.23, up 9.15% from 14.87, but still a low absolute level and below its 16.62 session high. NQ futures trade 30,463.00, down 1.38%, nearer their 30,357.75 low than the index is to its own. Cross-asset backdrop is genuinely difficult: the 10-year yield is 5.26% against a 5.18% prior close and close to its 5.27% high, Brent is $107.53 and WTI $95.23, each about 3% higher, with the energy move tied to an unresolved US-Iran and Strait of Hormuz supply situation where Saudi East-West pipeline shipments have been restored and prices have pared part of the earlier gain. Internals are weak but dispersed: ARM is down 8.52% at 283.90 and Qualcomm down 6.30% at 189.25, both near session lows, while Nvidia is higher after announcing a $150 billion buyback authorization, the largest single increase on record. Shared Finviz context collected at 14:34Z is partial, with futures and calendar sections unavailable; its available latest-session breadth, megacap and semiconductor sections are labelled non-real-time and were used only as confirming cross-asset context, showing all covered sectors lower, six of eight megacaps lower and six of seven semiconductors lower with high dispersion. Taken together this reads as an orderly, dispersion-driven drawdown inside a high-yield, high-oil regime rather than an observed persistent one-way price path, which places Tail at 23% with Stress at 84% and Confidence at 88%.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours ran from a calm late-Friday regime with Tail near 8-14% into an overnight repricing that lifted Tail into the 21-24% watch band from the 03:00Z hour onward, with Stress climbing steadily from 67% to the mid-80s. Two hours printed in the elevated band: 09:00Z at 26% during the European morning and 14:00Z at 27% as the US cash session traded down toward its low. Confidence improved throughout, from 75% to 88%, as live price-path and cross-asset evidence accumulated. Historical entries are the values published at the time and are not restated with later information.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds the watch band through the remainder of the US cash session, with one narrow elevated slot at 19:00Z covering the power hour, where late-session continuation risk on an unfilled gap-down day is highest. After the 20:00Z close the conditional path eases into the low band through the quiet post-close and Tokyo hours, on the assumption that no fresh energy or Hormuz headline arrives, while Stress stays high on the Brent and yield backdrop. The watch band returns from 03:00Z as European pre-market and cash hours transmit rate moves, and the second narrow elevated slot falls at 14:00Z on Sep 29, when JOLTS and CB Consumer Confidence both print inside the first hour of US cash trade. Forecast values are conditional risk, not an assertion that future price structure has been observed.
